text: The current tree test waits 250 ms, longer than the exported 200 ms transition, then asserts hidden or visible/layout state. Its comments explicitly decline a mid-animation assertion because the transition may already have completed. Keep that limit in review conclusions: reading this test supports final-state intent, not proof of transient visibility or runtime timing stability. No animation test was executed.
